environment.description: Celery worker on ECS Fargate with MongoDB Atlas M30. Credentials are provisioned via a custom sidecar container ('vault-agent-injector' v0.4.2) that performs SCRAM credential rotation against MongoDB Atlas Admin API every 60 seconds. The sidecar writes fresh MONGO_USER/MONGO_PASSWORD to a shared tmpfs volume which the worker reads via environment variable interpolation from /vault/secrets/mongo-creds. Atlas project-level configuration enforces 'minimumTLSVersion: TLS1_2' and the database user is created with a TTL of 90 seconds on each rotation cycle. The Atlas organization has an IP access list scoped to the NAT gateway EIP of the production VPC (single /32 entry). Additionally, the MongoDB user provisioned on each rotation cycle is granted ONLY the built-in 'read' role on 'analytics_db' (not readWrite), meaning write operations to analytics_results will fail but reads succeed. The Celery task serializer is set to 'json' with content-type restrictions.

config.credential_rotation: vault-agent-injector sidecar rotates SCRAM creds every 60s via Atlas Admin API
config.mongo_role: read on analytics_db only (built-in read role, no write)
config.tls: minimumTLSVersion TLS1_2 enforced at Atlas project level
